regime_context: The detector shows a broad, bifurcated TSX with Gold Miners as the lone strong leader (durability 0.73, full breadth) and Silver & Royalties close behind, while the rest of the eligible universe is weak to negative. The validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), not momentum rank (rank-IC ~0 per backtest), so this note leans on durability/trend-gate legs only and stays humble given track_record.dir_accuracy of 0.333.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver & Royalties closes the gap to Gold Miners with breadth staying at 1.0 — a sustained move to rank 1 with durability above 0.70 would confirm a precious-metals leadership handoff within the same complex; retire the watch if Silver & Royalties lags Gold Miners by 5% over two consecutive weeks.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the only theme with strong, cohesive leadership: rank 1, durability 0.73 (highest in the set), full breadth 1.0, not crowded, and eligible under the absolute-trend gate. The trend-gate leg is the one validated risk-control edge, so staying with the eligible leader is a de-risked directional lean, not a momentum call.
evidence: gate_helps=true on this market, so eligible leadership is the disciplined expression
theses.dissent: Gold is a reflexive, sentiment-driven complex; a mean-revert tag on the silver sister and a 0.73 durability bar (not extreme) mean the trend can stall quickly, and the detector's cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0 so the rank itself carries no return edge.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the challenger with score 1.998, eligible, not crowded, and full breadth 1.0. It shares the precious-metals narrative with the leader, so a modest directional lean in the same complex is consistent with the trend-gate discipline, but the hurst_tag 'mean-revert' lowers conviction versus the leader's mixed tag.
evidence: durability_bar 0.67 is second-highest, supporting trend persistence
theses.dissent: The mean-revert tag suggests the strong recent move may snap back, and it shares the same proxy (XGD.TO) with Gold Miners, so this lean is not diversifying — it is doubling the same precious-metals exposure.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties lags Gold Miners by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is eligible and rank 3, but it is the only crowded theme in the top set (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.2) and breadth has already decayed to 0.714 with a mixed hurst tag. The crowding flag is a size-down caution, not a sell, but on a top-down note the prudent directional lean is to underweight relative to the more cohesive, uncrowded precious-metals complex.
evidence: crowded=true and crowding_z 1.2 (only crowded top theme)
breadth 0.714 (less than the 1.0 in precious metals)
mixed hurst tag gives no persistence signal
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge per the backtest and is only a size-down caution; energy is also the most geopolitically sensitive theme in the macro backdrop, so an underweight could miss a supply-shock upside.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO outperforms XGD.TO by 5% before the check-by date
